description: JUnit test class for testing the behavior and correctness of the IfMatchPreconditionHeader class in the context of HTTP headers handling, focusing on immutability, key/value retrieval, and condition matching logic.

classes.name: IfMatchPreconditionHeaderTest
classes.description: Test suite for verifying the functionality of the IfMatchPreconditionHeader class, including immutability, header key/value retrieval, and condition matching.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the IfMatchPreconditionHeader class is immutable.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Checks that the header key returned by the header object is 'if-match'.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Ensures that the header value is retrieved correctly, e.g., "4711".

methods.name: meetsCondition
methods.description: Tests whether the header meets a condition when the EntityTag matches.

methods.name: doesNotMeetConditionForNull
methods.description: Tests that the header does not meet a condition when given null, unless the value is '*'.

methods.name: asteriskDoesNotMeetConditionForNull
methods.description: Verifies that an asterisk '*' does not match null.

methods.name: asteriskMeetsConditionForNonNull
methods.description: Verifies that an asterisk '*' matches any non-null EntityTag.

methods.name: ListMeetsConditionIfContained
methods.description: Checks if the header meets the condition when an EntityTag is in a list of tags.

methods.name: ListDoesNotMeetConditionIfNotContained
methods.description: Checks if the header does not meet the condition when an EntityTag is not in the list.

methods.name: fromDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates an IfMatchPreconditionHeader instance from DittoHeaders object and verifies its contents.

methods.name: createIfMatchPreconditionHeader
methods.description: Helper method to create a header for testing purposes, given EntityTagMatchers.
